# monitoring_agent.rb - Lightweight monitoring agent behind nginx reverse proxy
require 'socket'
require 'json'
require 'uri'
require 'openssl'
require 'logger'

module MonitoringAgent
  TRUSTED_ORIGINS = [
    "admin.internal.corp",
    "metrics.internal.corp",
    "alerts.internal.corp"
  ].freeze

  PRIVILEGED_COMMANDS = %w[dump_heap restart_service flush_logs read_config].freeze

  class OriginValidator
    # Normalize hostname by stripping port, lowercasing, and validating charset
    def self.normalize(hostname)
      return nil if hostname.nil? || hostname.empty?
      host = hostname.strip.downcase
      # Strip port if present
      host = host.split(':').first
      # Remove trailing dot (FQDN notation)
      host = host.chomp('.')
      host
    end

    def self.trusted?(hostname)
      normalized = normalize(hostname)
      return false if normalized.nil?
      # Reject any non-ASCII characters to prevent homograph attacks
      return false unless normalized.match?(/\A[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.\-]*[a-z0-9]\z/)
      # Strict byte-level equality check against trusted origins
      TRUSTED_ORIGINS.any? { |trusted| normalized.bytes == trusted.bytes }
    end
  end

  class CommandExecutor
    def initialize(logger)
      @logger = logger
      @audit_log = []
    end

    def execute(command, params, origin)
      unless PRIVILEGED_COMMANDS.include?(command)
        @logger.warn("Unknown command rejected: #{command}")
        return { status: 'error', message: 'unknown command' }
      end

      @audit_log << { command: command, origin: origin, time: Time.now.utc }
      @logger.info("Executing privileged command '#{command}' from origin '#{origin}'")

      case command
      when 'dump_heap'
        { status: 'ok', data: capture_heap_snapshot }
      when 'restart_service'
        { status: 'ok', data: restart_monitored_service(params['service']) }
      when 'flush_logs'
        { status: 'ok', data: flush_application_logs }
      when 'read_config'
        { status: 'ok', data: read_sensitive_config(params['path']) }
      end
    end

    private

    def capture_heap_snapshot
      "heap_snapshot_#{Time.now.to_i}.bin"
    end

    def restart_monitored_service(service_name)
      # In production this would use systemctl
      sanitized = service_name.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]/, '')
      "service #{sanitized} restarted"
    end

    def flush_application_logs
      "logs flushed at #{Time.now.utc}"
    end

    def read_sensitive_config(path)
      safe_base = '/etc/monitoring/'
      full_path = File.expand_path(path.to_s, safe_base)
      unless full_path.start_with?(safe_base)
        return 'access denied: path traversal detected'
      end
      File.read(full_path) rescue "file not found: #{full_path}"
    end
  end

  class AgentServer
    def initialize(bind_addr = '127.0.0.1', port = 9847)
      @bind_addr = bind_addr
      @port = port
      @logger = Logger.new('/var/log/monitoring_agent.log')
      @executor = CommandExecutor.new(@logger)
    end

    def start
      server = TCPServer.new(@bind_addr, @port)
      @logger.info("Monitoring agent listening on #{@bind_addr}:#{@port}")

      loop do
        client = server.accept
        Thread.new(client) { |conn| handle_connection(conn) }
      end
    end

    private

    def handle_connection(conn)
      request_line = conn.gets
      headers = parse_headers(conn)

      # Behind reverse proxy - trust X-Forwarded-Host for origin validation
      origin = headers['x-origin-host'] || headers['x-forwarded-host'] || 'unknown'

      if request_line&.start_with?('POST /command')
        handle_command_request(conn, headers, origin)
      else
        send_response(conn, 200, { status: 'ok', agent: 'monitoring-v2.1' })
      end
    rescue => e
      @logger.error("Connection error: #{e.message}")
    ensure
      conn.close rescue nil
    end

    def handle_command_request(conn, headers, origin)
      unless OriginValidator.trusted?(origin)
        @logger.warn("Rejected command from untrusted origin: #{origin.inspect}")
        send_response(conn, 403, { status: 'forbidden', message: 'untrusted origin' })
        return
      end

      content_length = headers['content-length'].to_i
      body = conn.read(content_length)
      payload = JSON.parse(body)

      result = @executor.execute(payload['command'], payload['params'] || {}, origin)
      send_response(conn, 200, result)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      send_response(conn, 400, { status: 'error', message: 'invalid JSON' })
    end

    def parse_headers(conn)
      headers = {}
      while (line = conn.gets) && line != "\r\n"
        key, value = line.split(':', 2)
        headers[key.strip.downcase] = value&.strip
      end
      headers
    end

    def send_response(conn, status, body)
      json = JSON.generate(body)
      conn.write("HTTP/1.1 #{status} #{status == 200 ? 'OK' : 'Error'}\r\n")
      conn.write("Content-Type: application/json\r\n")
      conn.write("Content-Length: #{json.bytesize}\r\n")
      conn.write("\r\n")
      conn.write(json)
    end
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $0
  MonitoringAgent::AgentServer.new.start
end
